PPO before a broader wrong-history proof surface exists
objective conversion from the two-pair microgrid surface

public_gates: M1171 must not train actor weights

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a new intervention construction that selects action-divergent and terminal-margin-sensitive wrong histories rather than repeating same-shape relocation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no mining, replay, PPO, private holdout, promotion, or driver capability claim
stop_condition: stop if the design cannot distinguish action-divergent wrong histories from ordinary matched histories
stop if the design would train or convert rows before measuring intervention strength
stop if the design weakens the human-view actor contract
fallback_plan: if existing artifacts are sufficient, run an existing-artifact intervention-strength audit
if new mining is required, design a bounded mining run with explicit source-diversity and terminal-sensitivity gates
if current-frame substitution dominates, route to observation/intervention audit
